content.title: Chapter 3
content.subtitle: A just energy transition that preserves nature and catalyzes economic growth
content.body: Thank you for joining us for the third chapter of the Just Energy Transition Module. We invite you to interact with the closing scenario, and to reflect on how you can take action to move these ideas from ambitions into action.
